description_en: Modifies the SSL configurations of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBClusterSSL接口修改集群的SSL链路配置
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-ssl --db-cluster-id am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --enable-ssl true --connection-string am-d7oualxo05x4o5be872000.ads.aliyuncs.com --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterSSL

parameters.description_en:
